title: blechnum rufum
intro: Blechnum rufum, commonly known as the rusty fern, is a species of fern native to Southeast Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Blechnum rufum include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and supporting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
